subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Think Time and Pacing
description: Learn Think Time and Pacing in one minute.

hook.text: A load test fires requests with zero delay. Real users read pages for 30 seconds between clicks.

buildup.text: Without think time, tests generate unrealistically intense load that no real traffic pattern produces.

discovery.text: Think time simulates the pauses real users take between actions—reading, deciding, typing.

twist.text: Too much think time makes tests too gentle. Too little makes them unrealistically aggressive.

climax.text: Calibrating think time from analytics produces load profiles that match production within 5% accuracy.

punchline.text: Real users pause. Your load tests should too.

quiz.question: What does think time simulate in load tests?
options: Pauses real users take between actions
